messages.speaker: companion
messages.text: Hey there! Welcome to the world! I'm {{companion_name}}, your companion.

messages.speaker: companion
messages.text: I'll be helping you survive out here in The Long Nights.

messages.speaker: companion
messages.text: Use WASD to move, and your mouse to look around. Let's explore together!

messages.speaker: companion
messages.text: Uh oh... it's getting dark. Ghosts come out at night!

messages.speaker: companion
messages.text: Stay alert and keep your health up. We'll get through this together!

messages.speaker: companion
messages.text: Wait... I see something strange in the distance. To the north.

messages.speaker: companion
messages.text: It looks like... an old structure? Some kind of ruin, maybe?

messages.speaker: companion
messages.text: We should investigate while it's still daylight. Ruins can be dangerous at night, but there might be treasure inside!

messages.speaker: companion
messages.text: This place is ancient... I wonder who built it?

messages.speaker: companion
messages.text: Stay alert. There might be enemies inside, and I see some kind of puzzle mechanisms.

messages.speaker: companion
messages.text: Look for glowing stones - they might teleport us to other places!

messages.speaker: narrator
messages.text: This is a test dialogue from the narrator!

messages.speaker: companion
messages.text: And now your companion is speaking!

messages.speaker: companion
messages.text: They can even change moods mid-conversation!

messages.speaker: npc
messages.text: Greetings, traveler. I am Zara, Keeper of the Ruins.

messages.speaker: npc
messages.text: I sense you are new to these lands. The ruins can be treacherous, and you may find yourself in dangerous places.

messages.speaker: npc
messages.text: Please, take this Keeper's Charm. It is a gift from the ancient keepers.

messages.speaker: npc
messages.text: If you ever find yourself in danger or somewhere inhospitable, hold the charm and left-click. It will return you safely to your home base.
